name: Kawasaki GPz550
engine: 553 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Kawasaki's early-80s sport 550. Shares a lot with the KZ550, but some trim parts are rare.

G: Clean the tank, lines and petcock before the rebuilt carbs go on. Rust and gunk from storage are common.
A: Some GPz550 parts were made for one model year only. Check part numbers before you buy.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Rust in the fuel system
known.what: Long storage fills the tank, lines and carbs with rust and gunk.
